title: SF: Man Convicted Of Drug Dealing In Tenderloin, Soma - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago A man was convicted Tuesday of drug trafficking and other crimes in San Francisco, the District Attorney's Office said. Edwin Mauricio Fiallos, 24, was found guilty by a jury of drug trafficking in the Tenderloin and South of Market neighborhoods of the city. He was also convicted of being in possession of fentanyl, cocaine base and methamphetamine for sale, as well as violating a stay-away order from another felony narcotics case, prosecutors said.
